profile.name: Kuzan

reasons.reason: Há benefícios condicionados a HP acima de um limite; recuperação e manutenção de HP recebem prioridade adicional.

evidence.text: When your HP is 70% or more: Damage dealt by normal attacks will disregard the enemy DEF stat.

reasons.reason: O personagem possui efeitos na área do próprio tesouro; há justificativa para um perfil defensivo nessa situação.

evidence.text: When in the area around your captured Treasure: Resist Stagger and Knockback. and Boost the cooldown reduction speed of Skill 1 by 50%.

profile.confidence: perfil com regras de traits reconhecidas

unmodeled.text: Nullify Freeze. and Nullifies Frostbite and Ice Ball.
When attacking an enemy in the area around your enemy's Treasure: Class changes to Attacker(s).
When you start refilling the Treasure Gauge: Class changes to Defender(s).
When dealing damage after holding down the normal attack button during the 1st hit of a normal attack combo and the 2nd hit of the attack changes: Knock enemies back.

Recovers the Treasure Gauge of the Treasure Area you transformed into a Chilly-Chilly Treasure Area (equal to 50% of your recovery amount, does not take on your other Trait effects, and Traits and effects related to Gauge recovery will not activate). and Recover 50% of percentage damage received from an enemy.
Can ignore the enemy and refill the Treasure Gauge. and Recovers the Treasure Gauge 50% past its maximum amount.
When attacking an enemy with the Element you are strong against: Remove enemy's DEF increase. and Increase damage dealt by 30%.
When in the area around your enemy's Treasure: Resist Stagger effect. and Removes current parameter reductions and nullifies incoming parameter reductions.
When in the Treasure Area: 1 HP will be left even if KO'd (ineffective if HP is exactly 1). and Nullify immobilizing status effects inflicted by enemy.
When attacking an enemy, 100% chance to: Increase DEF by 10% (increases up to 70% but resets once KO'd).
When attacking an enemy with a skill: 50% recovery of damage given (up to 5000). and Increase the cooldown time of the enemy's skill by 5%.
When attacking an enemy in a Treasure Area: Recover HP by 3%. and Nullify the Trait "1 HP will be left even if KO'd".
When attacking an enemy that is capturing Treasure: Increase the cooldown time of the enemy's dodging by 50%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 15%.
After receiving damage from an enemy which is 50% or more of your max HP: reduces damage received by 50%.

limitations: Pesos e fatores são heurísticos, não oficiais nem medidos em partidas.
Não simula dano final, evolução de skills, mapas, inimigos, troca de classe ou todos os traits.
Traits adicionais não estão equipados neste ranking. Recomendações de atributos são separadas.
Condições usam os fatores gerais 0,5 e 0,25; o cenário real pode mudar a ordem.
Os cinco sets podem compartilhar medalhas: não se força diversidade à custa da pontuação.
